summary:
SphereX Discovery: AI Investigators is a public-facing web tool designed to help everyday users explore NASA’s massive SPHEREx sky survey data.

What it developed: An intuitive, interactive web application featuring an integrated AI Assistant that translates plain-English user prompts into precise astronomical queries.

How it addresses the challenge: Instead of requiring manual inspection of billions of near-infrared objects across multiple time epochs, users can simply ask the AI to find changes. The tool automatically retrieves, aligns, and highlights shifting celestial bodies like asteroids, comets, and brown dwarfs.

Why it is important: It democratizes space exploration, removing steep technical barriers so that citizen scientists and the public can actively participate in making real cosmic discoveries.
details:
SphereX Discovery: AI Investigators is an interactive, public-facing web platform designed to bridge the gap between massive astronomical datasets and everyday explorers. Built to tackle the data deluge from NASA’s SPHEREx mission, the platform enables anyone to query, visualize, and track celestial changes without needing a background in professional astrophysics.

1. What It Does & How It Works

The project serves as an intelligent bridge between raw astronomical data and human curiosity:

  • Natural Language Queries: Powered by Gemini, users can type plain-English questions (e.g., "Show me shifting objects in Orion over the last year") instead of manually parsing complex astronomical coordinates.
  • Automated Data Processing & Alignment: The platform queries multi-epoch sky surveys, automatically aligning images taken across different time periods.
  • Immersive Visualization: It uses Three.js to render an interactive 360° sky environment and HTML5 Canvas to generate smooth time-lapse videos, allowing users to watch celestial bodies shift in real time.
    • Motion & Speed: ESA Gaia (DR3) and Barnard’s Star.
    • Historical Positions: NASA WISE.
    • Object Categories: WISE 0855 (Brown-dwarf), Epsilon Indi B (Binary), RW Aurigae & R Draconis (Brightness), and Comet 3I/ATLAS.
    • Coordinates & Spectra: Astropy / IVOA and NASA/IPAC IRSA (SPHEREx).

2. How the Project Is Creative

  • Conversational Astronomy: Transforming rigid database filtering into a fluid chat experience with an AI assistant makes exploring the universe feel intuitive and engaging.
  • Dynamic Time-Lapse & 3D Interactivity: Moving away from static star charts, the tool turns multi-epoch data into living, breathing animations where asteroids, comets, and brown dwarfs instantly reveal themselves through motion.

3. Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Democratizing Space Exploration: NASA's SPHEREx mission maps over a billion objects, creating a massive data bottleneck. This tool empowers citizen scientists, students, and astronomy enthusiasts to sift through data and spot anomalies independently.
  • Educational Engagement: By lowering the technical barrier to entry, it bridges formal research and public participation, sparking curiosity in STEM fields.

4. Core Focus Areas of Our Team

During the development of SphereX Discovery, our team focused heavily on several key pillars to ensure a well-rounded and professional submission:

  • Originality: Reinventing how people interact with sky survey data through conversational AI and immersive 360° visuals.
  • Accuracy: Grounding the platform in real astronomical pipelines, coordinates, and verified benchmarks (Gaia, WISE, SPHEREx).
  • Practical Relevance: Solving a real-world NASA challenge by making petabytes of public data genuinely accessible to the public.
  • Potential Impact: Opening up citizen science to millions of users worldwide.
  • Overall Presentation: Delivering a polished, intuitive, and visually stunning web interface.
